notes: §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR1: "all file control entries in the run unit which reference this file connector must have" the same OPTIONAL phrase, a consistent ASSIGN, the same RESERVE integer-1, organization, access mode, prime-key entry and location, and alternate keys (count, entries, locations, DUPLICATES). Since PB5069 landed, BinderDriver.Bind calls ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check at every edition; it groups the compilation group's EXTERNAL files by external name and compares each entry's FileEntryIdentity.Segments with the first describer's (COBOL6847), and imposes the 2023-only FILE STATUS item (COBOL1573/1624) only under DialectLevel >= 2023. Probed at 85 (classes b, e, c, d) with an indexed EXTERNAL file written by MAINPGM and read by SUBPGM, nested and as sibling programs: agreeing entries run (ALPHA, MAIN DONE); each item violated in turn is refused with COBOL6847 naming the clause: a OPTIONAL omitted, b ASSIGN "OTHERDATA", c RESERVE 3 and RESERVE omitted against 2, d RELATIVE, e RANDOM, f prime key moved after the alternate key and re-described PIC 9(4), g alternate key without DUPLICATES and alternate key count 0 (also between sibling programs); a non-external FILE STATUS in one entry compiles and runs at 85 (ALPHA 00) and is refused at 2023 (COBOL1624, COBOL1573). The witness runs two agreeing entries through both keys. Cross-compilation-unit agreement is checked only by the run time's EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH, which 1985 does not require. || kb/Work PB5567 (landed): FileEntryIdentity.Segments compares the ALT segment sorted (as COLL is), and COLL names an alternate key by its name, not by its place among the clauses, so entries listing the same alternate keys in another order agree (§1985:IX.2.3.3 SR1: any order); a DUPLICATES phrase that differs is still refused. Witnesses: pb5567-external-alternate-keys-in-another-order (runs: ALPHA, MAIN DONE) and pb5567-external-alternate-keys-duplicates-differ (COBOL6847 at every edition).

next.reason: 1985: "all file control entries in the run unit which reference this file connector must have: ... d. The same organization. e. The same access mode."; 2023: "i) The same specification of the FILE STATUS clause, where data-name-4 shall reference the same corresponding external data item.". 2023 keeps 1985 items a-g but also requires the same FILE STATUS clause, referencing the same external item, across entries. 1985 placed no such limit, so 2023 refuses programs 1985 accepted.
